datasets.name: carOBD (Toyota Etios 2014)
datasets.citation: 'Detecting Anomalies in the Engine Coolant Sensor Using One-Class Classifiers', IEEE, https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/8891367 (cited by the repo README; author names to be copied from the IEEE record - not verified offline).
datasets.license: No LICENSE file. README: 'open-source repository, free to everyone' and asks for citation. Redistribution terms are informal - treat bundled sample as 'cite, confirm before public release'.
datasets.ground_truth: none (no fault or anomaly labels; file name encodes operating mode only)
uses: synthetic-injection stress tests on held-out trips

datasets.name: DieselOBD
datasets.provider: Karim Lounis, Hadjer Mekki, Wissam Hadjab
datasets.citation: K. Lounis, H. Mekki, W. Hadjab. DieselOBD: A Real-World Dataset of OBD-II Parameters and Diagnostic Trouble Codes for Diesel Vehicle Fault Diagnosis. 2025.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in README; no separate LICENSE file)
datasets.ground_truth: vehicle-level DTC tags only (constant per vehicle); not per-sample diagnoses
uses: optional leave-one-signature-out experiment only - no fault-classifier enabled in app

datasets.name: APS Failure at Scania Trucks
datasets.provider: Scania CV AB via UCI ML Repository
datasets.citation: APS Failure at Scania Trucks. Scania CV AB, donated by T. Lindgren and J. Biteus, 2016. UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 421.
datasets.license: aps_failure_description.txt states GNU GPL v3 (Copyright 2016 Scania CV AB). UCI page license not re-verified.
datasets.ground_truth: binary per-record APS failure label (anonymized truck features)
uses: standalone truck-APS classification benchmark only - never mixed with car OBD data

datasets.name: Automotive OBD-II Dataset (KIT)
datasets.ground_truth: road-condition labels in file names (normal/free/busy) - NOT mechanical faults
uses: candidate second replay/benchmark source once manually downloaded
